prompt_summary: Refine the existing transparent no-accessory Naeru into a close-up-ready full-body master. Preserve its exact friendly three-quarter pose, proportions, solid oval eyes, mouth, arms, long tongue, striped belly, feet and curled tail. Replace enlarged heavy outline bands with delicate warm gray-brown contours and preserve soft hand-painted pink shading, transparent margins and the original silhouette. Add no hat, scarf, clothing, background, shadow or text. The approved thin-line close-up redraw and its solid-eye correction are used as the single autumn master.
